source.notes: Geometry preserved from the bundled country topology. Orthographic projection and geographic clipping generated with the bundled D3/TopoJSON; no geographic silhouette drawn by hand.

usage: All path strings use SVG coordinates in a 900 × 900 frame. For the Europe view, paths extend outside the frame: clip the containing frame. Keep sphere/land/graticule/borders/accents as separate layers to bind their colors to variables. Cities are data only, never drawn into the supplied SVGs. visible tests the front hemisphere; inFrame tests the viewport; showLabel requires both.
